# Map fixture sprites (real art)

The fixture maps in `tests/fixtures/maps/*.json` (and a few tests that build maps inline) reference these files. The map validator only checks that each file **exists** inside the base directory (`at_the_beginning/world_map/validate.py`, `_sprite_problem`: `is_file()` plus a path containment check). No test reads their size or pixels, so plain placeholder tiles are enough.

All six are 48x48 RGBA. They were made with PIL on 2026-11-18 (R0.1 / T1 follow-up S1) as one plain opaque fill colour each. On 2026-11-19 all six were replaced by real art (owner decision): only art that is cleared to commit, meaning project-original art or Codex originals drawn without pack images as input (h024 receipts: `edit_input` none). The scaling script is kept with the orchestration reports (`h024_build.py`); objects are RGBA with a transparent background, and tiles are opaque.

`myassets/terrain/grass.png` (48x48) also exists, but it was deliberately **not** copied here: `myassets/` images stay out of git and their licence is unverified. Other near-matches in `myassets/` (`a1/sprites/forge-local-a1-v1.png`, `props/tree_small.png`) were left out for the same reason. That grass and `props/tree_small.png` come from the Hypnobius pack, whose terms forbid standalone redistribution. `terrain/plank_floor.png` is the exception: it is project-original (generated by a repository script), so it became `floor.png` on 2026-11-19.

Note: the repository's `.gitignore` ignores `*.png`, so these files are committed with `git add -f`.
